obs: "It provides that attorneys fees shall be awarded unless the court finds that the position of the United States was substantially justified. 28 U. S. C. 2412(d)(1)(A) (emphasis added). This formulation, as opposed to simply unless the position of the United States was substantially justified, emphasizes the fact that the determination is for the district court to make, and thus suggests some deference to the district court upon appeal."
Highmark Inc. v. Allcare Health Management System, Inc.
